title: G-Maiden Pack Transfer Protocol
description: Contract between G-AnnStudio (sender) and G-Maiden (receiver) for announcer pack installation. Phase 1: local folder. Phase 2: HTTP + auth. Phase 3: cloud relay.

phase-1-local.description: Both apps on the same machine. G-AnnStudio writes to a shared folder, reads G-Maiden's selected loopback port from %LOCALAPPDATA%/G-Maiden/gsi-port.txt, verifies /health, then POSTs the install notification.

phase-2-remote.description: G-AnnStudio sends pack over HTTP to G-Maiden on LAN/remote. Requires shared secret.

phase-3-cloud.description: G-AnnStudio uploads to cloud relay; G-Maiden pulls. Auth via per-user API key.

x-auth-spec.description: Auth design for Phase 2+. Prevents unauthorized pack injection.

handshake.step-1: G-Maiden generates a pairing token on first run (random 32-byte hex), stores in config
handshake.step-2: User copies token into G-AnnStudio settings (one-time)
handshake.step-3: G-AnnStudio signs each request with HMAC-SHA256(token, body)

request-headers.X-GAnn-Signature: HMAC-SHA256 hex digest of the request body
request-headers.X-GAnn-Timestamp: Unix epoch seconds (reject if > 5 min drift)

events.description: Event IDs included in this pack
